## Description

Queue of export, correction, erasure and practice-closure requests from owners. Closure: full export first, records kept under a hold for the legal retention period, then deleted with a certificate; region never changes. Operations run the jobs and see counts and status only, never records.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a closure is requested, when it is approved, then a full export is delivered before any retention clock starts.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given retention ends, when the job runs, then records are deleted and a certificate is stored.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given an operator, when opens a request, then no record content is shown.

## Notes / open questions

- Scope (ADR-016 (docs/adr/ADR-016-organisation-onboarding-and-approval.md)): offboarding is at organisation level and covers all its locations. Removing one location is a separate, smaller action: its staff scope and schedules end, but patients are one shared record per organisation, so removing a location never deletes patients or charts. A Suspended organisation keeps its data untouched and readable for care while the suspension lasts. A Rejected applicant never held patient data (set-up-only mode); its request, uploaded documents and set-up are deleted after a retention period to be set with counsel (MDV-P1-044).
